12.t: Working with data: nerve impulse speeds
q: Calculate the time for an impulse to travel 1 m along the motor neurone.
Use two rows to explain the effect of the myelin sheath.
The touch neurone (myelinated, 8 µm) is 50 times faster than the slow pain neurone (no myelin, 1 µm); myelin speeds up impulses.
The squid axon is huge but slower than human motor neurones. Explain what this shows.
Myelin speeds impulses far more than width does: the squid needs a 500 µm axon to reach 25 m/s, while a thin myelinated neurone reaches 90 m/s.
